# ✨ Feature Request

Have an idea that could make **DerList** even better? We'd love to hear it!

Please provide as much detail as possible to help us understand your idea.

---

## 💡 What problem would this solve?

Describe the problem, frustration, or limitation you're experiencing.

> Example:
> "I can't easily compare prices across multiple wishlists."

---

## 🚀 Proposed Solution

Describe the feature you'd like to see.

How should it work?

---

## 🎨 Mockups or Examples

If you have screenshots, sketches, mockups, or links to similar implementations, include them here.

> Drag & drop images directly into this issue.

---

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions

Have you considered another way to solve this problem?

Describe any alternatives you've thought about.

---

## 🎯 Who would benefit?

Select all that apply.

- [ ] Everyone
- [ ] New users
- [ ] Power users
- [ ] Self-hosted instances
- [ ] Developers
- [ ] Mobile users

---

## ⭐ Priority

How important is this feature to you?

- [ ] Nice to have
- [ ] Important
- [ ] Very Important
- [ ] Critical

---

## 📦 Additional Context

Include any additional information that may help.

Examples:

- Similar websites or apps
- Links
- Research
- Use cases
- Technical ideas

---

## ✔️ Checklist

Before submitting, please confirm the following:

- [ ] I searched existing issues to make sure this hasn't already been requested.
- [ ] This is a single feature request (not multiple unrelated ideas).
- [ ] I explained the problem this feature would solve.
- [ ] I included examples or mockups if applicable.
